about.en: STORM is the governance and utility token of Storm Trade, a decentralized perpetual-futures exchange on TON that runs as a web app and a Telegram bot and lists crypto, stock, forex and commodity markets. It is the jetton EQBsosmcZrD6FHijA7qWGLw5wo_aH8UN435hi935jJ_STORM on TON. It is unrelated to the older Ethereum Storm Token.
